From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: 2-Day Revenue Triage: Pipeline stage updates & PO readiness (June close)

Team —

We have two business days until month/quarter close; this thread is to consolidate stage hygiene and PO readiness for the ACME deal (RD-ACME-2027-Q2-23) so finance can include it in the June revenue forecast. Please do the following by EOD today: 

- Owners: confirm commit level (Committed/At Risk/Unlikely) and final close date.
- Legal/Proc: confirm whether ACME needs any SLA or contract redlines that would delay PO.
- Finance: confirm whether we need to withhold recognition without a signed PO.

Quick facts: ACME expects a single PO for enterprise subscription; ops requested the purchase form on 6/17. I attached the latest pipeline snapshot and the PO draft we received.

Action items (fill inline):
- Priyom: please confirm owner-level commit and whether we should mark as "Commit (Finance OK)" or "Commit (Pending PO)".
- Ben: double-check the pricing tier and any approved concession (we offered a 10% onboarding credit).
- Lauren: if there are legal redlines outstanding, flag now; we may need to pause recognition.

I will escalate to Finance if we don't have a firm PO by EOD Monday (6/21).

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
